searchText: One average block (15 - 20mb witness size), it takes about 60ms. Yeah, this is round trip time from CL PoV That’s pretty much negligible 🙂 Yeah... For the worse case, I guess we should clarify and say it’s worse case size? Yeah, would also include the average case Yep was mostly thinking that it’s not the worse case block which has the max number of trie changes for example It was mostly a worse case execution witness size (so it’s possible that a block with a ton of writes goes above 1 second for example is what I’m saying) Yeah, I get what you are saying and I think that could be very correct... But just to be sure I would modify the spamming tool to simulate this, it's abit tricky though... I think if I can spam a block whose txs have alot of write op would do justice to this. My only concern is that, during testing, I am working with a node having a fresh trie, do you think i should be worried about that? Ah right, I think so because it may not be representative of mainnet given the node depths will be shallow We could leave it as an open question and measure it once we hook everything up to the EEST tests Alright! sounds good!
